name: django CMS
description_en:
django CMS adds visual page authoring to Python/Django applications. Developers define templates, placeholders and reusable plugins; editors then arrange and update content in the website context. It is especially relevant when a public content site must share authentication or business logic with an existing Django application.

The software is free and open source, but implementation, Python hosting, maintenance and plugin compatibility are operating costs. Publishing controls depend on the selected extensions and configuration. Treat the CMS core, the quickstart package set and a commercial implementation as separate scopes when evaluating a proposal.
description_zh:
django CMS 为 Python/Django 应用增加可视化页面创作。开发者定义模板、占位区和复用插件，编辑者再在网站页面中排列、更新内容。公共内容站需要与现有 Django 应用共享认证或业务逻辑时，它尤其值得评估。

软件免费开源，但实施、Python 主机、维护及插件兼容仍是运营成本。发布控制取决于所选扩展和配置，评估方案时应区分 CMS 核心、快速启动所装软件组合与商业实施范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Developers establish editable regions and content components; editors compose pages without writing the underlying application code.
core_features.explanation_zh: 开发者建立编辑区域及内容组件，编辑者组合页面，无需编写底层应用代码。

core_features.explanation_en: Reuse Django applications, authentication and custom business logic alongside managed content. Integration still requires development.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可将 Django 应用、认证及定制业务逻辑与受管内容结合，集成仍需开发。

core_features.explanation_en: Language-specific content/URLs and shared multi-site infrastructure are documented; shared infrastructure does not itself prove tenant isolation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档列出分语言内容/URL及多站共享基础设施；共享基础设施本身不能证明租户隔离。

pricing.summary_en: Free open-source software without license fees. Development, Python hosting, maintenance, selected services and extensions are separate costs; no numeric service quote verified.
pricing.summary_zh: 开源软件免费，无许可费；开发、Python 主机、维护、所选服务及扩展另计，未核实数字服务报价。

sections.title_en: Connect editorial pages to a Django application
sections.title_zh: 将编辑页面连接 Django 应用
sections.en:
Consider a university department site that also has a custom Django course application. A developer can keep the course model and authentication in Django, create page templates with editable placeholders, and supply a course-summary plugin. An editor can update the introduction and arrange that component, while application code owns the course data. This is an illustrative architecture, not an integration run or a guarantee that an existing app works unchanged.

The FAQ identifies Python/Django teams, multilingual organizations and custom application/content combinations as target uses. A team wanting a fully hosted, no-developer page service should budget for a partner or compare a managed builder; the CMS does not remove the need to design and operate the application.
sections.zh:
例如大学院系站另有自建 Django 课程应用。开发者可在 Django 保留课程模型及认证，创建可编辑占位区模板，并提供课程摘要插件；编辑者更新介绍及排列组件，课程数据仍由应用代码管理。这是架构示例，未经集成执行，也不保证现有应用无需修改。

FAQ 将 Python/Django 团队、多语言机构及应用与内容结合列为适用场景。希望全托管且无需开发者的团队，应预算合作伙伴服务或比较托管建站工具；CMS 并不免除应用设计及运营工作。

sections.title_en: Define what an editor can change and publish
sections.title_zh: 定义编辑者可修改及发布的范围
sections.en:
Content plugins sit inside page placeholders and can represent rich text, media, forms or custom business components. Editors can rearrange and preview them; developers remain responsible for the template and component design. For an acceptance exercise, give an editor access to one language and page group, change text and a reusable component, and inspect both preview and public pages with a separate viewer.

The homepage promotes full versioning, while the more specific FAQ says draft/published states, approvals, scheduling, revisions and moderation depend on installed extensions and project configuration. The installation tutorial explicitly includes djangocms-versioning and djangocms-alias in its starter package set. Do not assume every bare installation includes the same workflow, or that an approval role is enforced until tested.
sections.zh:
内容插件位于页面占位区内，可表示富文本、媒体、表单或定制业务组件。编辑者可排列及预览，模板和组件设计仍由开发者负责。验收可给编辑者一个语言及页面组的权限，修改文本和复用组件，再以独立访客检查预览与公开页面。

首页宣传完整版本管理，但更具体的 FAQ 明确草稿/发布、审批、定时、修订及审核取决于扩展和配置。安装教程的启动包明确包含 djangocms-versioning 和 djangocms-alias，不能假定每个最小安装具有相同工作流，也不能在未测试时认定审批角色已强制执行。

sections.title_en: Use a version-matched tutorial before production planning
sections.title_zh: 先用匹配版本的教程，再规划生产
sections.en:
The public getting-started page describes creating a Python virtual environment, installing django-cms, running djangocms with a project name, and starting the Django development server. The actual latest tutorial read is labeled 5.2.0dev1, requires Python ≥3.10 and Django familiarity, and uses SQLite. It says the shortcut creates a project from cms-template, installs its selected packages, migrates the database, prompts for a superuser and runs the CMS check. These steps were read, not executed.

That development tutorial is not evidence of the requirements for every supported stable release or a production recipe. Select the intended released version, check its Python/Django/plugin matrix and deploy with appropriate database, static/media storage and WSGI/ASGI infrastructure. The FAQ distinguishes Python-capable hosting from ordinary PHP hosting. Debug development settings and runserver are not a production acceptance result.
sections.zh:
公开入门页描述建立 Python 虚拟环境、安装 django-cms、以项目名运行 djangocms，然后启动 Django 开发服务器。实读 latest 教程标为 5.2.0dev1，要求 Python ≥3.10 和 Django 基础，使用 SQLite；快捷命令从 cms-template 建项目、安装所选包、迁移数据库、提示创建超级用户并运行 CMS 检查。上述步骤仅阅读，未执行。

该开发教程不能证明全部受支持稳定版的要求，也不是生产方案。需选择目标正式版，核对其 Python/Django/插件兼容矩阵，并配置合适数据库、静态/媒体存储及 WSGI/ASGI 基础设施。FAQ 区分可运行 Python 的主机与普通 PHP 主机，开发调试设置和 runserver 不构成生产验收。

sections.title_en: Plan frontend editing and multilingual scope together
sections.title_zh: 同时规划前端编辑和多语言范围
sections.en:
Developers can use custom templates and Bootstrap, Tailwind or JavaScript frontends. The FAQ cautions that highly dynamic JavaScript interfaces may require additional work so frontend editing can process page updates. A React label alone therefore does not establish an editable end-to-end integration.

Documented language features include per-language URLs, editing, copying and fallbacks. Multi-site setups can share authentication, infrastructure, code and applications. Test fallback content, language-specific publication and cross-site permissions with realistic accounts; shared infrastructure is a design option rather than proof of access isolation. These content-language capabilities are not a verified list of interface translations in this record.
sections.zh:
开发者可使用定制模板，以及 Bootstrap、Tailwind 或 JavaScript 前端。FAQ 提醒高度动态的 JavaScript 界面可能需要额外工作，让前端编辑处理页面更新，因此单有 React 标签不能证明全流程可编辑集成已成立。

文档列出分语言 URL、编辑、复制及回退。多站可共享认证、基础设施、代码和应用，应使用真实账户测试回退内容、分语言发布及跨站权限；共享基础设施是设计选项，不是访问隔离证明。这些内容语言能力也不代表本档案已核实界面翻译列表。

sections.title_en: Separate free software from the cost of ownership
sections.title_zh: 区分免费软件与使用总成本
sections.en:
The official site says the software has no license fee and identifies a BSD open-source license in its footer. This supports free/open-source classification, but the exact BSD variant and complete notice were not read here; obtain the release license before redistribution. Paid implementation or support does not make the core proprietary.

The FAQ lists development, hosting, upgrades, security monitoring, custom plugins, migration, training, support and Association membership among possible costs. No standard numeric hosting or implementation price was established. Choose services explicitly rather than treating membership or a professional support contract as a prerequisite for using the free software.
sections.zh:
官网称软件不收许可费，页脚标为 BSD 开源许可，支持免费/开源分类；本次未读取 BSD 具体变体及完整声明，再分发前应取得所用版本许可。付费实施或支持不会令核心变为专有软件。

FAQ 列出开发、托管、升级、安全监控、自定义插件、迁移、培训、支持及协会会员等可能成本，本次未建立标准数字托管或实施价格。应明确选择服务，不能将会员或专业支持合同当作使用免费软件的前提。

sections.title_en: Validate the chosen extension set and recovery path
sections.title_zh: 验证选定扩展组合和恢复路径
sections.en:
The FAQ notes that extension maintenance varies, recommends staging and plugin compatibility checks for upgrades, and ties scaling to implementation and infrastructure such as caching, CDN and database design. Its security and performance statements are vendor/project descriptions, not an independent audit or benchmark.

For a pilot, migrate a small bilingual content set, test an application component, exercise the required publishing roles and restore database/media together. Establish who patches Python/Django/CMS dependencies and third-party packages. This research did not install the CMS, test apphooks, publish pages, measure load, confirm a support SLA or restore a backup.
sections.zh:
FAQ 指出扩展维护质量不同，升级时建议暂存环境及插件兼容检查；扩展能力取决于缓存、CDN、数据库设计等实现及基础设施。安全和性能描述来自项目方，不是独立审计或基准测试。

试点可迁移少量双语内容、测试应用组件、验证所需发布角色，并将数据库和媒体一同恢复；明确由谁维护 Python/Django/CMS 依赖及第三方包。本次未安装 CMS、测试 apphooks、发布页面、测负载、确认支持 SLA 或恢复备份。
